task: Hetzner Cloud console: rescale one server to a bigger type in place (e.g. CX23 to CX33), keeping the disk the same size so it can be scaled back down later

steps.human: Sign in to your Hetzner account in this tab (accounts.hetzner.com, plus 2FA if you have it). Press Done when you see your projects.

steps.do: Open the project and the server Jax names in the chat. Report its current type, location and status before changing anything.

steps.human: The server must be off to rescale, and the bot on it goes offline for about 2-3 minutes. Press Power > Power off yourself, then Done.

steps.do: Rescale tab: choose the target type Jax gives in the chat, keep 'CPU and RAM only' (disk unchanged, so it can scale back down). Do not submit.

steps.human: Check the new type and monthly price. Press Rescale yourself, then Done.

steps.do: Wait for the rescale to finish, then press Power > Power on and wait until the status reads Running.

accept: The server shows the new type and is Running. Jax confirms over SSH that memory matches the new type and that the bot's containers came back.
notes: Money-changing and downtime steps (power off, Rescale) are human steps.
Sign-in runs on accounts.hetzner.com, which is deliberately off the allow list, so the extension lets go of the tab while the person signs in.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential.
